activity.notes: Khomeini was the founder and first Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic. ATLAS uses the constitutional Supreme Leader tenure rather than extending the office backward over his pre-republic revolutionary leadership.

sources.title: KHOMEINI
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica identifies Ruhollah Khomeini as leader of the 1978-79 Islamic Revolution and founder of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

sources.title: Ruhollah Khomeini
sources.citation_text: Britannica identifies Khomeini as the Iranian religious leader who led the revolution and remained the country's ultimate political and religious authority until his death in 1989.
